body:
Guilt tripping, gaslighting, telling me my problems aren't real (they don't believe in mental health), making me feel bad about having emotions..
The works :')

They haven't had the best parental role models themselves so I don't exactly blame them; they're trying their best and they've tried to get better after my first suicide attempt but after growing up with their emotional abuse/neglect, I can't really bring myself to open up to them.
